name: pengo
description: Pengo desktop build and release tools (the UI needs no bundler)

scripts.build:appimage: node scripts/release/build-config.mjs && tauri build --bundles appimage --config update-build.json
scripts.test: node --experimental-vm-modules scripts/test-shortcut-fallback.cjs && node --experimental-vm-modules scripts/test-updates.cjs && node --test scripts/test-release.mjs
